meta.source: FTN charting joined to nflverse pbp on game_id + play_id; targets attributed via pbp receiver_player_id

readValues.firstRead: the throw the play was designed to produce
readValues.secondRead: the quarterback came off his first look
readValues.checkdown: a target that means the play broke down

caveats: Rates are a share of DROPBACKS, never of all snaps — dividing play-action by every play halves it and reads a play-action offence as a conventional one.
FTN charting is done by humans and the standard is not identical across seasons.
A target is attributed through pbp's receiver_player_id, so a charted pass with no recorded receiver counts for the team and for nobody in particular.
